name: Seiin Ningyou Hime Rizell
source:
Princess Liselle of the Kingdom of Gardenia is assassinated at her birthday party. Sorcerer manages to bind her soul to a homunculus body, but to maintain the body princess needs to drink a lot of semen every day. Girl initially thinks that such fate is worse than death, but eventually will for life takes over.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
加迪尼亚王国的莉泽尔公主在生日宴会上遭到暗杀。一名术士设法将她的灵魂固定在炼金人偶的身体里，可为了维持这具身体，公主每天都必须喝下大量精液。起初，少女觉得这样的命运比死亡更加痛苦，但求生意志最终还是占据了上风。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
